title: Astrona question bank v1
description: A knowledge check (quiz) for a training: one YAML file listed in astrona.yaml as `type: quiz`. `astrona content validate ats` checks the same rules and a few more (source_readings exist, ids are unique).

id.description: Stable id of the bank, e.g. ats014-020-01.

course_id.description: The training this bank belongs to, e.g. ATS014.

exam_code.description: The exam the questions practise for, if any.

status.description: `draft` is allowed but `astrona content validate` warns until a person has reviewed the questions.

provenance.description: Where the questions come from, e.g. original practice material, not official exam questions.

questions.description: The site uses the first 30 questions.

id.description: Unique in the bank. Keep it stable once published.

type.description: The only supported type; may be left out.

source_readings.description: Repository paths of readings (as listed in astrona.yaml) to read again. Each must exist.

id.description: Unique in the question, e.g. a, b, c.

explanation.description: Why this option is right or wrong. Shown after answering; a missing one is a warning.

correct_option.description: The id of one of the options.

explanation.description: Why the answer is right. A missing one is a warning.
